content: {"episode_id": "ep-05192", "cpt": "93229", "denial_carc": "PR-204", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction, currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations that raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during these symptomatic events to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms. This service is medically necessary to identify an arrhythmia that may be the source of the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms, as documented in the clinical indication note."}
